ABOUT

A little about me.

I’m a Data Engineer based in Arlington, Texas, with 2+ years of combined professional and internship experience.

My work has taken me from banking ETL at LTIMindtree to healthcare pipelines at Elevance Health. I’ve worked on incremental ingestion, data modeling, reconciliation, and the checks that keep reporting data accurate.

I completed my MS in Computer and Information Sciences at Southern Arkansas University in December 2025. During my master’s, I built a PySpark streaming project to handle duplicate transactions and late-arriving events.
